name: shell-insight
description: When the agent stops with shells still running, say what it is waiting for, in a row above the prompt.

enabled.title: Enable Shell Insight
enabled.description: Show what the stopped agent is waiting for.

model.title: Summary model
model.description: A model alias or ID accepted by the host.

language.title: Summary language
language.description: Language tag for the waiting summary.

maxScriptBytes.title: Script byte limit
maxScriptBytes.description: Skip files larger than this limit.

summaryTimeoutMs.title: Model timeout
summaryTimeoutMs.description: Maximum model request duration in milliseconds.

redactSecrets.title: Redact likely secrets
redactSecrets.description: Mask common credentials before sending text to the model.

ignorePaths.title: Ignored paths
ignorePaths.description: One path per line. Never read or send matching scripts.
